op_is_valid_77byte_signed.meaning: a valid 77-byte signed UserOperation exists whose owner signature covers only the 65-byte rawSignature and userOpHash

relayer_holds_op.meaning: the relayer/bundler holds that valid 77-byte signed operation

suffix_excluded_from_hash.meaning: getUserOpHash excludes the signature field so the last 12 bytes (validUntil/validAfter suffix) are not part of userOpHash

executed_outside_window.meaning: the signed AtomWallet operation is executed at a time outside the user-approved validUntil/validAfter window

assumptions: The relayer submits the modified UserOperation for validation and execution (a_submit_op).
AtomWallet verifies the owner signature only over userOpHash and the stripped 65-byte rawSignature (rc_unauthenticated_suffix).
The validUntil/validAfter window is carried in the last 12 bytes of userOp.signature.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete validUntil/validAfter values or execution timestamp, so the outside-window relation is represented by a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric time comparison.

limitations: The outside-window execution is described as potential capability, not an observed incident.
The window enforcement relation is encoded as a Boolean because no numeric time bounds are supplied.
